verdict.rationale: Skyvern documents an official MCP server that lets AI assistants such as Claude Desktop, Claude Code, Codex, Cursor and Windsurf control a browser, exposing 117 browser and automation tools (open a cloud browser, click, type, extract, log in with stored credentials). A probe confirms the dedicated MCP docs page exists. Missing for 10: independent or hands-on corroboration of the MCP server in use, and setup, transport and auth details in the evidence.
